action_vocabulary.accept_current: Placement is visually correct; classify the named check as inapplicable.
action_vocabulary.change_host: Bind the object to a different reviewed canonical host.
action_vocabulary.delete_duplicate: Remove a proven duplicate while preserving its source evidence.
action_vocabulary.offset_facade_normal: Move a facade outward along its already-authored normal.
action_vocabulary.offset_from_mass_boundary: Move a ground object outward from a named building boundary.
action_vocabulary.orientation_axis_180: Treat the object's long axis as undirected modulo 180 degrees.
action_vocabulary.reclassify: Change the semantic module before placement is recomputed.
action_vocabulary.set_carrier_lateral_offset: Use an evidence-backed signed distance from the named carrier.
action_vocabulary.set_minimum_span_endpoint_lateral: Move the span endpoint nearest its carrier to a reviewed roadside offset.
action_vocabulary.unresolved: Evidence is insufficient; require human review or more evidence.
